title: Ealing Broadway Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, walk-in centres, and essential supply points for Ealing Broadway and West Ealing.
content:
For life-threatening medical emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals
- Ealing Hospital: Uxbridge Road, Southall UB1 3HW. From Ealing Broadway station: ~35 min walk west along Uxbridge Road, or bus 207, 427, or SL8 west along Uxbridge Road (~15 mins).
- Charing Cross Hospital: Fulham Palace Road, London W6 8RF. From Ealing Common station: ~15 mins east on District or Piccadilly line to Hammersmith, then a 10 min walk south along Fulham Palace Road.
- St Mary's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Praed Street, London W2 1NY. From Ealing Broadway station: ~15 mins on the Elizabeth line east direct to London Paddington station.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- Ealing Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Uxbridge Road, Southall UB1 3HW (located at the Ealing Hospital site).

3. Local Hazard Notes
- River Brent corridor immediately west of West Ealing (Brent Valley Park) presents river flood risk; surface runoff pooling can occur in rail underpasses around Haven Green and Broadway.

4. Essential Supplies
- Major pharmacies and supermarkets along Ealing Broadway (The Broadway, High Street, New Broadway) and West Ealing Broadway supply drinking water, first-aid materials, and medicines during outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
